summary: Upgraded the QEMU boot smoke from handoff-only to runtime-aware. The initramfs builder now embeds Alpha runtime markers derived from the staged rootfs manifest into the early /sbin/agentd output, and the boot smoke gate requires QEMU serial output to contain the handoff marker, runtime artifact marker, and rootfs runtime manifest hash marker.

acceptance_evidence.boot_handoff_observed: Full QEMU smoke observed AGENTD_HANDOFF_OK on the serial output.
acceptance_evidence.runtime_availability_observed: Full QEMU smoke observed AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ARTIFACTS_OK and the rootfs runtime manifest hash marker on the serial output.
acceptance_evidence.manifest_tied_to_runtime_artifacts: boot-smoke-test.ps1 reads image/out/agentos-initramfs.manifest.json, checks policy/tools/ModelBroker/run/audit/rollback/memory artifact IDs, and fails when IDs are missing or failed.
acceptance_evidence.failure_logs_actionable: The smoke records dependency-check.json, boot-smoke.log, and boot-smoke-result.json under .workflow/artifacts/boot/.
acceptance_evidence.generated_artifact_hygiene: Boot logs, cached kernel, initramfs, staged rootfs, and generated manifests remain under ignored artifact/image/cache paths.

blocking_alpha_risks_remaining: Distribution Alpha release/provenance promotion gate is still required.
FullRootfs validation still requires installed agentd.boot, agentd.runtime, release.provenance, and release.rootfs_manifest.
Firecracker, package install isolation, and untrusted content workstreams remain planned.
